CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_INDIVIDUALCUSTOMER_SEC
AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer AS 
(
SELECT
     BSC.CLTCODE AS CustomerId
    ,BSC.CNAME AS IndividualCustomerName
    ,BSC.BDATE AS DateOfBirth
    ,BSC.SEX AS SexId
    ,BSC.BPLACE AS BirthPlace
    ,BSC.SPOUSE AS SpouseName
    ,BSC.RELATIONSHIP AS DosriTypeId
    ,BSC.REFERREDBY AS RelatedPartyTypeId
    ,BSC.FATCAFLAG AS FATCAIndicator
    ,BSC.TIN AS TaxIdentificationNumber
    ,BSCD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BSC.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BSC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BSC.SOURCE_CODE
FROM BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT_DELTA BSCD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.SEC_TBLCLIENT BSC ON BSC.CLTCODE = BSCD.CLTCODE AND BSC.ISLATEST = 1
WHERE BSC.CLTTYPE = 'I' 
)   

SELECT * INTO #TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer FROM TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,IndividualCustomerName
,DateOfBirth
,SexId
,BirthPlace
,SpouseName
,DosriTypeId
,RelatedPartyTypeId
,FATCAIndicator
,TaxIdentificationNumber
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)

,
TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,IndividualCustomerName
,DateOfBirth
,SexId
,BirthPlace
,SpouseName
,DosriTypeId
,RelatedPartyTypeId
,FATCAIndicator
,TaxIdentificationNumber
)) HASHROW, CustomerId
FROM BNKM.IndividualCustomer WHERE SOURCECODE = 'SEC'	
)
,
TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	--,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerStatusTypeId,TGT.CustomerStatusTypeId) AS CustomerStatusTypeId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer_DELTA FROM TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer_DELTA;

------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
 IndividualCustomerName = SRC.IndividualCustomerName
,DateOfBirth = SRC.DateOfBirth
,DateOfDeath = NULL
,SexId = SRC.SexId
,GenderId = NULL
,EthnicCategoryId = NULL
,RacialCategoryId = NULL
,PreferredName = NULL
,ShortName = NULL
,NameSuffix = NULL
,BirthPlaceCountry = NULL
,BirthPlaceCity = NULL
,BirthPlace = SRC.BirthPlace
,SpouseName = SRC.SpouseName
,NonResidentIndicator = NULL
,EmployeeIndicator = NULL
,Dosri = NULL
,DosriTypeId = SRC.DosriTypeId
,MinorIndicator = NULL
,Segment = NULL
,RelatedPartyIndicator = NULL
,RelatedPartyTypeId = SRC.RelatedPartyTypeId
,FATCAIndicator = SRC.FATCAIndicator
,FATCATypeId = NULL
,TaxIdentificationNumber = SRC.TaxIdentificationNumber

FROM BNKM.IndividualCustomer TGT
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
WHERE TGT.SOURCECODE = 'SEC'


-------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.IndividualCustomer
(
     CustomerId
    ,IndividualCustomerName
    ,DateOfBirth
    ,DateOfDeath
    ,SexId
    ,GenderId
    ,EthnicCategoryId
    ,RacialCategoryId
    ,PreferredName
    ,ShortName
    ,NameSuffix
    ,BirthPlaceCountry
    ,BirthPlaceCity
    ,BirthPlace
    ,SpouseName
    ,NonResidentIndicator
    ,EmployeeIndicator
    ,Dosri
    ,DosriTypeId
    ,MinorIndicator
    ,Segment
    ,RelatedPartyIndicator
    ,RelatedPartyTypeId
    ,FATCAIndicator
    ,FATCATypeId
    ,TaxIdentificationNumber
    ,SourceCode
    ,FinancialInstitutionId
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm
)
SELECT
     CustomerId AS CustomerId
    ,IndividualCustomerName AS IndividualCustomerName
    ,DateOfBirth AS DateOfBirth
    ,NULL AS DateOfDeath
    ,SexId AS SexId
    ,NULL AS GenderId
    ,NULL AS EthnicCategoryId
    ,NULL AS RacialCategoryId
    ,NULL AS PreferredName
    ,NULL AS ShortName
    ,NULL AS NameSuffix
    ,NULL AS BirthPlaceCountry
    ,NULL AS BirthPlaceCity
    ,BirthPlace AS BirthPlace
    ,SpouseName AS SpouseName
    ,NULL AS NonResidentIndicator
    ,NULL AS EmployeeIndicator
    ,NULL AS Dosri
    ,DosriTypeId AS DosriTypeId
    ,NULL AS MinorIndicator
    ,NULL AS Segment
    ,NULL AS RelatedPartyIndicator
    ,RelatedPartyTypeId AS RelatedPartyTypeId
    ,FATCAIndicator AS FATCAIndicator
    ,NULL AS FATCATypeId
    ,TaxIdentificationNumber AS TaxIdentificationNumber
    ,SOURCE_CODE AS SourceCode
    ,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
    ,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM #TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer
WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer;
DROP TABLE #TMP_BNKM_IndividualCustomer_DELTA;

END
